claims.claim: The autosave status indicator in the wizard reflects the live connection state (for example, saving or offline) for the server autosave.
claims.finding: The wizard's Status pill can only show Ready, Saving or Error: the status type includes "offline" (VisitWizardV4.tsx:1590) and the pill has an "Offline" branch (VisitWizardV4.tsx:18864), but nothing ever sets it to offline. Losing the connection shows Error, not Offline. The app header shows its own Offline badge when the device is offline (AppShell.tsx:1573-1578).
claims.proposed_text: The wizard header shows the autosave status (Ready, Saving, or Error) and an Auto-save On / last-saved indicator. If your device loses its connection, the app header shows an Offline badge and the wizard status shows Error until a save goes through again. Neither is an offline mode you turn on.
claims.reason: Nothing sets the wizard status to offline; a lost connection shows Error in the wizard and an Offline badge in the app header.
